Name: Bi Petroberry Chicken
Author: bansaighdear
Description:
My first ever re-color mod. :)

It works with 1.6.15 respectively SMAPI 4.2.1 / Content Patcher 2.6.1 (tested on Windows 10).

It will not recolor the blue and golden chickens! Only the white, brown and void chicken and chicks.

Use at your own risk! It is possible that this mod crashes your game, so make sure you have a backup of your save BEFORE using this. I do not take responsibility for any crashed games or lost saves.
